//: Type tests for the GENERATED wasm .d.ts — wasm-bindgen emits it from the `typescript_type` / `typescript_custom_section` attributes in `crates/protect-ffi/src/wasm.rs`. Separate from the root tsconfigs because these need `npm run build:wasm` to have run AND `lib/` to exist (the generated .d.ts imports `../../lib/types.js`) — `npm test` must still pass in a fresh clone with no dist/. Run via `npm run test:typecheck:wasm`.
//skipLibCheck: @tsconfig/node20 turns skipLibCheck on. This config exists to check one generated .d.ts, so leaving it on hides the errors that matter: with it on, a missing lib/ reports a spray of TS2305/TS2578 against the test file; with it off, one TS2307 naming the unresolvable module.
